hero.headline: Bring Sodafom into your classroom
hero.subtext: Curriculum-aligned games, class progress tracking, and up to 30 pupil profiles — everything you need to make learning irresistible.

features.title: Class progress dashboard
features.description: See every pupil's stars, games played, and subject strengths at a glance. Spot who needs extra support instantly.

features.title: Curriculum alignment
features.description: Every game is mapped to the UK National Curriculum. Filter by year group, subject, and topic to assign targeted practice.

features.title: Class leaderboard
features.description: Motivate pupils with a private class leaderboard — first names only, fully opt-in, and always kind.

features.title: Weekly reports
features.description: Automated weekly summaries emailed to you every Monday — no manual data entry required.

features.title: Assign daily challenges
features.description: Set a specific game as the class daily challenge and track how many pupils complete it.

features.title: Printable certificates
features.description: Generate and print personalised achievement certificates for every pupil — great for parents' evening.
